name: search-layer
title_zh: 四源合一，自动去重的智能搜索层
tagline_zh: 同一个问题，Brave、Exa、Tavily、Grok 四路并查，按意图调权重、去重再合成。查事实、找资料。
tagline_en: One query, four engines — Brave, Exa, Tavily, Grok — intent-scored, deduped, and synthesized. Stop tab-hopping.
desc_en: DEFAULT search tool for ALL search/lookup needs. Multi-source search and deduplication layer with intent-aware scoring. Integrates Brave Search (web_search), Exa, Tavily, and Grok to provide high-coverage, high-quality results. Automatically classifies query intent and adjusts search strategy, scoring weights, and result synthesis. Use for ANY query that requires web search — factual lookups, rese
why_zh: 不是简单聚合，而是先判意图再调策略：事实型、研究型、实时型各有权重，去重后合成答案，比单引擎更稳。
why_en: It doesn't just merge results — it classifies intent first, reweights per engine, dedupes, then synthesizes. Smarter than any.
limit_zh: 需要自备 Brave、Exa、Tavily、Grok 四个 API key，缺一个就少一路；只覆盖网页搜索。
limit_en: Requires all 4 API keys (Brave/Exa/Tavily/Grok); web search only, no file or DB lookup; output is a text summary, not citation-formatted.
